lede: S&P 500 falls 3.7% and Nasdaq drops 5.3% as AI selloff deepens; 10-year yield slips. Anthropic falls about 9% in first full trading day after record IPO.

items.title: ECB President Lagarde gives keynote 'Acting in time' at Frankfurt banking congress
facts: Lagarde spoke on Nov. 20 at the 36th Frankfurt European Banking Congress.
The ECB held its deposit rate at 2.50% in late October; the next decision is Dec. 17.
items.why: Euro-area inflation is running around 4%, so ECB tone shapes euro and Bund pricing ahead of December.

items.title: UK retail sales volumes rise 0.7% in October after a September fall
facts: The Office for National Statistics (ONS) says volumes rose 0.7% in October and were 2.3% above a year earlier.
September's decline was revised to 0.6% from 0.4%; food stores gained after the government's Be Ready campaign began Oct. 22.
items.why: A one-off stock-up boost complicates the Bank of England's read on consumer demand.

items.title: Anthropic falls about 9% in first full trading day after record IPO
facts: Shares fell 9.1% to $88.30, still above the $83 IPO price.
The stock had opened at $111.50 on its first day and closed at $97.17.
items.why: The largest recent AI listing fell with the sector, hurting appetite for new tech issues.

items.title: Anthropic raises $93.5 billion in total after underwriters take up the overallotment
facts: Underwriters exercised the greenshoe option on the IPO priced at $83 per share.
Total proceeds reached $93.5 billion.
items.why: The size of the raise sets a record for equity capital markets before the selloff.

items.title: Corpay invests $1.1 billion for about a third of Bill in a TPG-led $6 billion buyout
facts: The price is $63.25 per share, valuing Bill at about $6.0 billion; Bill would delist from the NYSE.
Corpay gets an option to buy the rest of the company in 2030.
Closing is expected in the first half of 2027, subject to approvals.
items.why: A major payments company takes a stake in a corporate-payments rival through a private-equity deal.

items.title: Boston Scientific prices about $7.25 billion of dollar and euro senior notes
facts: The dollar offering is $3 billion in four tranches, from 5.375% due 2029 to 5.875% due 2036.
A euro offering of 4.25 billion euros was priced through a European subsidiary and is guaranteed by the parent.
Closing is expected on December 1, 2026.
items.why: A large debt raise from a big medtech issuer shows borrowing costs near 5.4% to 5.9% in dollars.

items.title: S&P 500 falls 3.7% and Nasdaq drops 5.3% as AI selloff deepens; 10-year yield slips
facts: S&P 500 lost 265.44 points to 6,910.39; Nasdaq Composite fell 1,261.47 points to 22,617.73, turning negative for 2026.
The Dow fell 1.93% to 48,147.33 on Friday, November 20.
The 10-year Treasury yield fell to 4.92% from 5.04% as bond prices rose.
items.why: A broad equity drop with falling yields shows money moving out of AI stocks into Treasuries.

items.title: S&P 500 and Dow close in correction; seventh straight S&P loss, worst week since April 2025
facts: The S&P 500 is down more than 10% from its October 6 record and lost 8.6% this week.
The S&P 500 has now fallen seven sessions in a row.
The Nasdaq erased its 2026 gain, down about 2.7% for the year.
items.why: A correction and a seventh straight decline mark the sharpest market stress in over a year.

items.title: Chip and AI stocks lead the rout: Nvidia, AMD, Micron and Broadcom fall 12% to 14%
facts: Nvidia closed about 13.8% lower and AMD fell 13.3%.
Micron slid 13.9% and Broadcom dropped 12.1% on Friday.
Amazon, Google and Microsoft also closed lower.
items.why: Heavy losses in the largest chip and cloud names drove the index declines.
